authority.implementation_bugfix: seen-goal accumulation and per-goal observability only
authority.source: user instruction to diagnose the common all-zero wiring, fix a concrete defect, and rerun the bounded normal gate

forecast.basis: reuse the original conservative preregistered peak forecast; observed original 32-job tree was 80,258,114,089 bytes
forecast.reserve_rule: max(8 GiB, 20% of projected peak writes)

capacity_preflight.live_tree_rule: never move a live checkpoint tree; any migration requires a completed checkpoint, verified copy/hash, switched path, successful resume, then source cleanup
capacity_preflight.runtime_enforcement: recheck before every job and checkpoint; stop at a complete resumable checkpoint if projected writes plus reserve are no longer available

evaluation.discounted_return_definition: success * gamma^(length-1) for length >= 1, otherwise zero; the fixed normal delivery evaluator has unit reward on the success step
evaluation.evaluator_family_mapping: natural_reset is the canonical evaluator label for the manifest's natural-start family
evaluation.exact_tie_breaker: earlier candidate order in the frozen registry
evaluation.gate: selected candidate must achieve at least 29/32 natural-start successes independently for seeds 110 and 111
evaluation.oracle_boundary: delivery success is scored by project-owned fixtures; independent kernel and scripted-oracle tests validate the encoded task contract, not an external scientific ground truth
evaluation.selection_bias_boundary: the same validation layouts select the candidate and adjudicate this operational gate, so a pass is not held-out evidence of generalization

current_status_source_of_truth: this manifest owns the corrected fixed-normal rerun; the original development tree and result remain immutable historical evidence

defect_and_rerun_boundary.historical_tree_policy: do not resume from or overwrite the defective run; write a new RAID tree with new source hashes
defect_and_rerun_boundary.main_rule: never launch the 72-job main matrix automatically, regardless of the corrected gate result
defect_and_rerun_boundary.observability_change: update logs add per-goal commanded, successful, and seen counters
defect_and_rerun_boundary.only_training_semantic_change: runner.seen_goals now accumulates event.observed_goals after every rollout in both online-value and SD-SAC collectors

required_entry_checks: the smoke manifest records CPU 8/8 and GPU 8/8 passed with no checkpoint writes
the queue wrapper identity-checks and stops only --beyondg-gpu-keepalive processes, then sets HACKRL_DUMMY_KEEPALIVE_CLEARED=1
the interpreter and repository root match the paths declared here
every imported hackrl project module resolves beneath the declared clean worktree
the JAX backend is gpu on CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
the non-symlink run root itself is on the same device as /raid/ext_csv
a nonblocking single-runner lock is held
execution.resume: resume only from a complete checkpoint whose state hash, candidate, environment, seed, update, and execution-source hashes match; preserve and stop on any existing invalid checkpoint directory
execution.retention: retain all five development checkpoints per job; never prune failed seeds or final states
execution.run_root_override: forbidden; the runner must resolve exactly to the RAID path above

selection_and_stop.capacity_failure: stop before the next checkpoint write
selection_and_stop.nan_inf_or_hash_mismatch: stop the affected job and preserve artifacts

understood_as: After correcting the shared seen-goal accumulation defect and passing fresh CPU/GPU smokes, rerun exactly the original 32 fixed-normal development jobs with unchanged candidates, seeds, transition budgets, evaluation, selection, and stopping rules. Main adaptation remains closed.
